mapper.select: SELECT lease_owner,CAST(lease_generation AS CHAR) AS generation,lease_expires_at,execution_evidence FROM deletion_item WHERE item_id=#{itemId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT j.created_by FROM deletion_job j JOIN deletion_item i ON i.tenant_id=j.tenant_id AND i.deletion_id=j.deletion_id WHERE i.item_id=#{itemId}

SELECT p.object_key,p.object_version,p.sha256,p.state FROM object_upload_part p JOIN object_upload_session s ON s.tenant_id=p.tenant_id AND s.upload_id=p.upload_id WHERE s.purpose='SOURCE' AND (s.object_key=#{objectKey} OR EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM source_upload_result u WHERE u.tenant_id=s.tenant_id AND u.upload_id=s.upload_id AND u.source_version=#{sourceVersion})) ORDER BY s.upload_id,p.part_no
mapper.update: UPDATE deletion_item SET status='RUNNING',lease_owner=#{workerId},lease_generation=lease_generation+1, lease_expires_at=TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND,#{leaseSeconds},#{now}),revision=revision+1,updated_at=#{now} WHERE item_id=#{itemId} AND revision=#{expectedRevision} AND status IN ('QUEUED','RUNNING') AND (lease_owner IS NULL OR lease_expires_at<=#{now})
mapper.select: SELECT worker_receipt FROM deletion_item WHERE item_id=#{itemId}
mapper.update: UPDATE tenant SET governance_epoch=governance_epoch+1 WHERE governance_epoch=#{governanceEpoch}
mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM retrieval_hit h WHERE h.source_version=#{sourceVersion}) +(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lineage_edge e WHERE e.upstream_version_id IN (SELECT i.index_version FROM index_manifest i WHERE i.source_version=#{sourceVersion})) +(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reference_hold h WHERE (h.legal_hold=TRUE OR h.retain_until IS NULL OR h.retain_until>UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)) AND h.upstream_version_id IN (SELECT i.index_version FROM index_manifest i WHERE i.source_version=#{sourceVersion})) +(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM processing_attempt a WHERE a.source_version=#{sourceVersion} AND a.status IN ('QUEUED','RUNNING'))
mapper.update: UPDATE source_chunk SET raw_text='',search_text='',locator=JSON_OBJECT() WHERE source_version=#{sourceVersion} AND parse_version=#{parseVersion}
UPDATE content_node SET content_ref=JSON_OBJECT(),locator=JSON_OBJECT() WHERE source_version=#{sourceVersion} AND parse_version=#{parseVersion}
UPDATE source_read_history SET locator=NULL,revision=revision+1 WHERE source_version=#{sourceVersion} AND locator IS NOT NULL
UPDATE processing_attempt SET failure_manifest=JSON_ARRAY(),revision=revision+1,updated_at=#{now} WHERE source_version=#{sourceVersion} AND JSON_LENGTH(failure_manifest)>0
UPDATE parse_version SET failure_manifest=JSON_ARRAY() WHERE source_version=#{sourceVersion} AND JSON_LENGTH(failure_manifest)>0
UPDATE source_chunk SET search_text='' WHERE source_version=#{sourceVersion} AND parse_version=#{parseVersion}
UPDATE index_manifest SET status='WITHDRAWN' WHERE source_version=#{sourceVersion} AND index_version=#{indexVersion}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM source_chunk WHERE source_version=#{sourceVersion} AND parse_version=#{parseVersion} AND LENGTH(search_text)>0

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM processing_attempt WHERE source_version=#{sourceVersion} AND JSON_LENGTH(failure_manifest)>0) +(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM parse_version WHERE source_version=#{sourceVersion} AND JSON_LENGTH(failure_manifest)>0) +(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM source_read_history WHERE source_version=#{sourceVersion} AND locator IS NOT NULL)
